newsitem.title: INDIA: Mother Teresa conscious, breathing on own.
newsitem.headline: Mother Teresa conscious, breathing on own.

text.p: Mother Teresa was conscious and breathing on her own after suffering heart failure on Friday, and her doctor said he was hopeful the Roman Catholic missionary would recover.

"It is very difficult to say what her chances of recovery are," Dr Asim Kumar Bardhan, the 86-year-old nun's cardiologist, told reporters at Calcutta's Woodlands Nursing Home. "She is a chronic patient of heart disease. But we are hopeful."
The hospital released a medical bulletin which said she was admitted at 2:30 a.m. (2100 GMT Thursday) with acute left ventricular heart failure.
"Her irregular heart rate is persisting. At present she is fully conscious and comfortable," it said.
Bardhan said Mother Teresa's heart problem started at about 11:30 p.m. (1800 GMT) on Thursday. "Last night it was serious. But now she is breathing on her own," he said.
"She is getting treatment for heart failure and she is still under investigation. A team of doctors is looking after her," Bardhan said.
